How do I stop fearing death
</message>
output: I guess what I'm really asking is why it's gotten so loud in my head lately, why I can't just let it sit quietly in the back like other people seem to. I think I want someone to tell me it's normal, that wanting to feel okay doesn't mean I have to pretend I'm not scared. Maybe I just want to stop feeling like time is something chasing me instead of something I'm just living in.
